abstract: A male aged 48 visited our department on October 17, complaining of swelling of his left scrotal content from July, 1990. Physical examination showed the testis to be swollen to the size of a chicken egg, and ultrasound examination disclosed the swelling to be solid and nodular. Left high inguinal orchiectomy was performed on October 29. The testis extirpated was 50 x 40 x 45 mm in size and weighted 80 g; the gross appearance of the cut surface of the testis was nodular with grayish-white color. The lesion was proved to be spermatocytic seminoma histopathologically, but no hemorrhage or necrosis was observed. Radiation in the dose of 36 Gy was given over the left hypogastrium and paraaortic region in 36 Gy each. The patient subsequently did will and has been followed up in our outpatient clinic without evidence of recurrence as of 10 postoperative months. This patient was the 19th reported case of spermatocytic seminoma in Japan. However, General Rules for Clinical and Pathological Studies on Testicular Tumors explain that spermatocytic seminoma is usually seen in a pure form, unassociated with other types of germ cell tumors, making our case actually the 17th case of this particular seminoma if spermatocytic seminomas combined with other germ cell tumors are exclude from the statistical analysis. Reports of spermatocytic seminoma thus defined are reviewed in this study.(ABSTRACT TRUNCATED AT 250 WORDS)
abstract_ja: 48歳の男性が、1990年7月からの左陰嚢内容の腫脹を主訴に10月17日に受診した。身体所見では精巣が鶏卵大に腫大しており、超音波検査で充実性で結節状の腫脹が認められた。10月29日に左鼠径部高位精巣摘除術が施行された。摘出精巣は50×40×45mm、重量80gで、割面は灰白色の結節状を呈していた。病理組織学的に精母細胞性セミノーマと診断され、出血や壊死は認められなかった。左下腹部および傍大動脈領域に、それぞれ36Gyの放射線照射が行われた。術後10か月の時点で再発の所見はなく経過良好である。本症例は本邦で報告された精母細胞性セミノーマの19例目であった。ただし、精巣腫瘍の臨床および病理学的研究に関する総則では、精母細胞性セミノーマは通常、他の胚細胞腫瘍を伴わない純粋型で見られると説明されており、他の胚細胞腫瘍と合併したものを統計解析から除外すれば、本症例は17例目にあたる。この定義に基づく精母細胞性セミノーマの報告をレビューした。（抄録は250語で打ち切られている）
